grading_system.evidence: By earning all required 27 credits, students will demonstrate proficiency in all Springfield High School graduation standards (including both content standards and transferable skills).

schedule.evidence: Courses meet every day or every other day ("1 full meeting for a course that meets every-other day"); grade 12 may have "one open block each day." Number of blocks per day and courses taken at once are not stated.

credit_definition.text: A full semester course meeting daily is listed as 1.0 credit; some semester electives and health/PE courses are 0.5 credit; full-year courses are listed as 2.0 credits in some cases.
credit_definition.evidence: FOUNDATIONS OF READING & WRITING 10: Credit: 1.0 English. Duration: One Semester, meets daily.

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: Grades 9-11: full schedule required; grade 12: one open block per day if senior privileges earned (number of blocks not stated)
course_load.evidence: Students in grades 9 through 11 are required to carry a full schedule of classes. Students in grade 12 will be permitted one open block each day if they have earned senior privileges.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states 27 credits for the Class of 2027 and beyond; course listings use the same credit unit (semester course meeting daily = 1.0). Area minimums: English 4, Social Studies 3 (incl. 1 course on American history and government), Math 3 (Algebra 1 required), Science 3, World Language 1, Health 1, Art 1, PE 1.5, Financial Literacy 0.5, electives 9. Also 40 community service hours.

flexible_pathways_listed: courses at River Valley Technical Center
notes: Required local items: Algebra I must be passed (Algebra I Part 2 required for graduation if starting Part 1); Financial Literacy applies to Class of 2027 and beyond (met by Financial Literacy or Save Your Money. Know Your Rights.); Modern Society/Introduction to Social Studies required in grade 9; 40 community service hours required for all students (grade-promotion schedule lists 10/20/30 hours by year). Grade promotion thresholds: 10th 6 credits, 11th 13 credits, 12th 19 credits. Proficiency-based grading with GPA; catalog does not state a minimum score to earn credit.
